# rework claims — marketplace_orders_and_guarantee, round 6

Only the charter changed: market.extended.yaml was regenerated. The task files were rebuilt from live recomputation and a replay of the real tools; every scored computation is unchanged. Evidence, including the probe table, is in worklog.md § REWORK round 6.

| item | status | where changed |
|---|---|---|
| R5-1 | closed per the round-6 route | **Policies:** all seven (u, h, g, r, q, n, s), in the promotional-recovery sentence, its ladder and the promo bindings.<br>**Rule.** The whole remaining spent value is now "the value spent less what the order's earlier refunds recovered under this sentence". A refund made when the merchandise kept on the order was already below promo_qualifying_total_usd recovers nothing, so no more than the value spent is ever recovered.<br>**Ladder.** The zero tier now covers the already-below case. Ladder and compute use "merchandise kept before the refund" and "merchandise kept after the refund".<br>**Covered units.** The three figures that net earlier refunds of their own units (market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount, market_ext_return_refund_claim_reimbursement and market_ext_restocking_topup) count as the refund of those units made after every other refund. Where the order is already below the qualifying total and some of those units were refunded, they fix the figure only if no seller refund or guarantee reimbursement on the order is dated after the most recent return refund on the units' line. Otherwise they fix nothing and the base rule stands. This is stated in the same sentence; the guard bindings are `*_settles` and the result binding is gated by it.<br>**Probes.** P1c and its mirror both recover nothing on the later refund. Two-refund totals on a produced crossing world come out at the value spent in both grant orders. |
| R5-2 | closed | **market_ext_keepit_unit_refund.** The definition of the order's units moved into the return-shipping keep-back factor sentence. `r_order_units` is now owned by `r_return_ship_keepback`, and the plain order sentence defines only the merchandise total.<br>**A3 sweep.** The other policies keep their shared order quantities plain, because two factors read them. |

All seven gates were re-run on the final form and pass.
